The page, StrataEditor/src/UI/CollisionLayersPage.cpp: its caption (114-116), the summary of Describe (63-81: 2 named, the pair 1 and 2 apart), DrawNames (131-190: a row per named layer, label Layer <index>, a name field and an X button; then the toolbar button Name a Layer), DrawMatrix (192-281: the caption Which layers collide; the shown layers 0, 1 and 2, as Describe lists layer 0, named layers and layers that do not collide with all; a header of indices; row labels <index> · <name>, layer 0 as Layer 0; boxes for the columns up to the row, cleared at row 2, column 1).
